title: Implement budgeted tree-of-thought search
prompt: Budgeted best-first repair search over hashable states. expand(state)->iterable; score is larger-is-better; verify returns Boolean. Limit depth, children per expansion, and verifier calls; deduplicate states on insertion. Return first verified state or None plus verification trace. This core models call/depth budgets, not tokens or a real program-analysis proof.
